verification.method: scripts/verify/econ-batch2.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; then the rendered text was read by hand
verification.what: Every figure in the direct answer, indicator cards, Key facts, story, comparison figures, table, CSV, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD, and the claim behind each sentence (records, 'since' years, rank positions, G7 comparisons)
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0)
verification.result: All 3,164 automated comparisons across the five pages matched; build-time assertions caught and corrected two wrong 'since' claims (Japan inflation: since 1981, not 1991; Australia income peak: 2013, not 2012) before publishing

changelog.note: First version: World Bank WDI figures (update of 11 November 2026).
